description:
It was an inevitable end of the world. A food shortage due to environmental pollution, followed by a food war.

On the verge of the apocalypse, which everyone knew but chose not to stop, A huge figure of God appears in the sky.

Those who have seen God wept, repented of our sins, and regaining our faith, taurus, immortals, and yokais that were thought to be non-existent come out into the world once again.  
 
One day, 30 years after the world became stable, Dan Na-bi, an ordinary 16-year-old schoolgirl, makes a deal with the Jeok-myung guru; To be forgotten in the memories of others in exchange for her classmates who are in danger of dying.  
 
Na-bu has been kicked out of the house and has nowhere to go, in which she meets Lee Yun-oh, a half-man, half yokai boy in a similar situation. Na-bi, together with Yun-oh, seeks help from the private guru Sal-gwi.  
The two of them have no choice but to become guru.
